name: Dazzling Theater // Prop Room
clause: Creature spells you cast have convoke. // Untap each creature you control during each other player's untap step.

needs.proposedSignature: A static { kind: 'grant-cost-modifier'; scope: 'your-spells'; filter?: Filter; from?: CastZone; modifier: CostModifier }, and a binding for the convoking creatures: ObjectSet word 'convoked' ({ op: 'for-each', over: 'convoked' }) and Filter { convokedSource: true }.
needs.semantics: First half: 'Spells you cast from exile have convoke' / 'Creature spells you cast have convoke' - a permanent granting a cost modifier to a class of spells. Second half: the engine must remember which creatures were tapped to convoke a spell, so 'Each creature that convoked this spell connives' and 'shares a creature type with a creature that convoked this spell' can name them.
needs.clause: Spells you cast from exile have convoke. / Each creature that convoked ~ connives.

needs.proposedSignature: TriggerEvent 'cast' gains self: true ('When you cast this spell'); trigger-twice.event gains 'attacks'; a new event { on: 'untap-step'; whose: 'your' | 'each' | 'opponent' }.
needs.semantics: 'When you cast this spell, ...' (Emrakul) cannot be written because `cast` takes a Filter that cannot mean 'this spell'; Wulfgar needs trigger doubling for attack triggers; Prop Room needs 'during each other player's untap step'.
needs.clause: When you cast ~, gain control of all creatures target player controls.
